meta.title: Keyboard navigation
meta.description: Adds three keyboard behaviours: Ctrl+Up / Ctrl+Down move the selection in the plugin area (the sidebar's panel rows, with the Conversation first), Alt+Up / Alt+Down step through the sessions of the current workspace only (never across workspaces, in the sidebar's default last-update order), and Ctrl+J returns the caret to the current Session's input box. Empty-composer Up/Down recalls sent-message text from loaded history, and Ctrl+M opens the official model selector without changing the draft. Every editable binding is in Settings → General → Keyboard shortcuts. The plugin/session arrow chords default on Windows and macOS Desktop only; message-history arrows are fixed local input, and Ctrl+M uses Ctrl+Alt+M on Web. No Host service, model request, or network traffic.
